property_summary: For any user and any funded balance, calling withdrawBalance causes the recipient (msg.sender) to receive exactly the previously stored balance amount; the mutant that calls the recipient with value 0 can leave the stored balance unpaid and so will cause the recorded received value to differ from the stored balance.
change_summary: Replace the external call with a call that sends zero value, causing the transfer to succeed but not forward funds and leaving balance nonzero (call still may revert on failure).
